avoid_when: Avoid when the opening page needs a prominent image, logo, or detailed agenda.
Avoid when multiple content sections or data visualizations must appear on the same slide.
families.description: A sparse corporate cover centers the presentation title in a strong color band, followed by presenter details and a small date.
families.digest: cover with title band and presenter details
families.name: cover-hero
selection_hints: Use for a formal presentation opening with a centered title and presenter credentials.
Choose when a restrained corporate cover with ample white space is appropriate.

avoid_when: Avoid when a detailed conclusion, action list, or contact information is needed.
Avoid when the closing page should feature imagery or branding.
families.description: A minimalist closing page built around one large centered two-line statement with ample white space.
families.name: closing-hero
selection_hints: Use as a simple final slide for formally ending a presentation.
Choose when one prominent closing or thank-you message is sufficient.

avoid_when: Avoid when the content does not need a supporting visual.
Avoid when presenting multiple parallel topics or data-heavy analysis.
families.description: A clear two-column content slide pairs a large left-side visual with a detailed explanatory text block on the right.
families.digest: title with diagram and explanatory text
families.name: content-split
selection_hints: Use for explaining one concept with a prominent supporting image or diagram.
Choose when a visual and a substantial text explanation should receive balanced emphasis.

avoid_when: Avoid when the content cannot be organized into a structured matrix.
Avoid for image-led storytelling or a small set of simple bullets.
families.description: A bold header introduces a large comparison table, followed by a rounded callout that emphasizes the principal takeaway.
families.name: content-title_body
selection_hints: Use for a detailed matrix-style comparison with multiple columns and rows.
Choose when a structured table needs a prominent concluding takeaway.
Suitable for presenting criteria, feature sets, schedules, or categorized evidence.

avoid_when: Avoid when the content needs visuals, data charts, or side-by-side comparison.
Avoid when more than one major content section must be shown.
families.description: A conventional content slide pairs a prominent colored title band with a large single-column bullet area.
families.name: content-title_body
selection_hints: Use for a straightforward topic explained through several bullet points.
Choose when one key point may require a longer description than the others.

avoid_when: Avoid when the agenda needs descriptions, timing, or section owners.
Avoid when a visual roadmap or multi-column agenda is preferred.
families.description: A restrained agenda slide uses a prominent blue title band above a spacious single-column numbered contents list.
families.name: agenda-title_body
selection_hints: Use near the beginning to preview a short presentation structure.
Best for roughly three to six concise section titles.
